name: IBY_PAY_INSTRUCTIONS_ALL
description: IBY_PAY_INSTRUCTIONS_ALL stores information on payment instructions. A payment instruction is a set of one or more payments submitted together to a payment system. This table corresponds to the Payment Instructions tab of the Funds Disbursement Process Home.

columns.name: PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION_ID
columns.description: System generated primary key

columns.name: PAYMENT_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Payment process profile Identifier

columns.name: PROCESS_TYPE
columns.description: Specifies the process by which payments are built into payment instructions. Values from the lookup IBY_PROCESS_TYPES include STANDARD, IMMEDIATE, and MANUAL.

columns.name: PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION_STATUS
columns.description: Payment instruction status. Values from the lookup IBY_PAY_INSTRUCTION_STATUSES include CREATED, FORMATTED, and TRANSMITTED.

columns.name: PAYMENTS_COMPLETE_CODE
columns.description: Code indicating whether payments in the payment instruction have been marked as complete. Values from the lookup IBY_PAYMENTS_COMPLETE include YES, NO, and PARTIAL.

columns.name: GENERATE_SEP_REMIT_ADVICE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N flag indicating whether a separate remittance advice needs to be created for a payment instruction. If the flag is set to Y, then at least one payment within the payment instruction requires a separate remittance advice.

columns.name: REMITTANCE_ADVICE_CREATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether any separate remittance advice documents were created for a payment instruction. By default this flag is set to N.

columns.name: REGULATORY_REPORT_CREATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a regulatory report, for example, for central bank reporting, has been created for a payment instruction

columns.name: BILL_PAYABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N flag indicating whether a payment instruction consists of bills payable

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity Identifier of the payment instruction. This column is populated only when first party legal entity is specified as a grouping rule for payment instruction creation.

columns.name: PAYMENT_COUNT
columns.description: Number of payments comprising this instruction

columns.name: POSITIVE_PAY_FILE_CREATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a positive pay file has been created for a payment instruction

columns.name: PRINT_INSTRUCTION_IMMED_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N flag indicating whether the payment instruction is printed immediately after the payment instruction is created

columns.name: TRANSMIT_INSTR_IMMED_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N flag indicating whether the payment instruction is transmitted immediately after the payment instruction is created

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: INTERNAL_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Internal bank account Identifier of the payment instruction. This column is populated only when internal bank account is specified as a grouping rule for payment instruction creation. This column is always populated for printed payment instructions, as they are required to be created for a single internal bank account.

columns.name: PAY_ADMIN_ASSIGNED_REF_CODE
columns.description: Administrator assigned reference code

columns.name: TRANSMISSION_DATE
columns.description: Date that the payment instruction is sent to the bank

columns.name: ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_DATE
columns.description: Acknowledgment date

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: User entered notes

columns.name: BANK_ASSIGNED_REF_CODE
columns.description: Payment system-provided reference code for this payment instruction

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: ORG_TYPE
columns.description: Organization type. Values from the lookup IBY_ORGANIZATION_TYPES include Operating Unit, Business Group, and Legal Entity.

columns.name: PAYMENT_DATE
columns.description: Payment date of the payment instruction. This column is populated only when payment date is specified as a grouping rule for payment instruction creation.

columns.name: PAYMENT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency of the payment instruction. This column is populated only when payment currency is specified as a grouping rule for payment instruction creation. This column is always populated for printed payment instructions, as they are required to be for a single payment currency.

columns.name: PAYMENT_SERVICE_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the payment process request which had its payments grouped into the payment instruction. This column is populated when payment process request is specified as a grouping rule for payment instruction creation.

columns.name: PAYMENT_FUNCTION
columns.description: Function or purpose of the payment. Values from the lookup IBY_PAYMENT_FUNCTIONS include SUPPLIER_PAYMENT, CUSTOMER_REFUNDS, and others.

columns.name: PAYMENT_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Payment reason code. This column is populated when Payment Reason is specified as a grouping rule for payment instruction creation.

columns.name: RFC_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: Identifier of the regional finance center at the bank branch level pertaining to the payments in the instruction. This column is populated when RFC is specified as a grouping rule for payment instruction creation.

columns.name: PAYMENT_REASON_COMMENTS
columns.description: Free text describing a reason for the payments in the instruction. This column is populated when Payment Reason is specified as a grouping rule for payment instruction creation.

columns.name: PAYMENT_DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Payment document that was passed to the payment instruction creation program, if it is different from the default in the payment process profile

columns.name: PRINTER_NAME
columns.description: Name of the printer to be used for printed checks

columns.description: Numeric sequence of AMEX remittance file sent by customer. This number is used by American Express to check for skipped or duplicated files.
